# DX-91 Migration Fixtures

Focused regression fixtures for DX-91 migration semantics.

Each fixture includes:
- `EXPECTATION.md`: exact migration expectation and spec links.
- `input/`: pre-migration repository snapshot.
- `expected/`: expected post-migration repository snapshot.

Scope of this fixture set is creation only. Runtime migration implementation is out of scope.

Canonical semantics source:
- `docs/proposals/DX-91-migration-semantics.md`
